items.text:
Like the others say, the game has bugs and a lack of content. But I believe, based on my experience with watching Neo Scavenger, that the game will eventually be excellent. 

The game starts with your character on a ship where you can choose your characters gender and pronouns. You can also randomize the avatar's face but I don't believe customization is in the game. You continue by choosing your career and answering a questionnaire about how you deal with particular situations nets your character skills and money. Once you complete that you can use some of the money to buy equipment for work. Currently it is somewhat limited with a crowbar, laser system (that I wasn't able to figure out how to use), work flashlight, food (which gave one of my characters food allergies and killed them). You can also choose the characters attributes like strong, feeble, genius. I'm uncertain at this time how much of an affect this plays on the game but I know that the food sensitivity one works as do some of the ones that govern your character's emotions.

Once you've done all of that, you can finalize your character and launch on your space ship. When you do that you are transitioned from the starting area to a small single room ship. Currently there is no tutorial so you'll need to click around and figure out how to do certain things. Sitting at the Navigation chair allows you to pilot your ship while looking at a cool 70s (think Ridley Scott's Aliens) terminal. You can lock on to a specific destination and fly over to it. This requires some skill as it is kind of easy to rotate uncontrollably until you get a feel for the controls. Once you get close to your target a proximity klaxon will start beeping as your increase your distance. You switch over to docking mode, connect to the target and dock your ship. Docking relies on you lining up your ship so that the docking clamps can connect. This isn't too hard unless you are moving too fast. 

Having connected successfully to the derelict ship, the time has come for you to go and scavenge for parts. Because your character is new and doesn't have a lot of money, you are initially required to scavenge in lunges because you don't have the EVA suit and when you put on your space suit, you only have air for a couple of minutes so you have to get into the derelict, uninstall whatever scrap you want and then get back to your ship before passing out and dying. If you manage to get this far you will come to the only problem I've found with the game so far. 

Your ship, until you find a generator, runs on batteries that drains as your ship produces thrust, heats the interior, produces air, et al. Once that drains down all power is shut off on board your ship and you can no longer control whichever direction you are going in or even see how far other things are. Additionally, there isn't a way (that I have found) to recharge the batteries. So in my case I was able to make one derelict run and then had to head back to the K-leg (first space station) where I became marooned because I couldn't figure out how to get more energy for my ship. I was able to make a decent amount of money selling the scrap that I had taken from the derelict though and bought more drinks and food.

While stuck at the station I was able to talk to the other friendly NPCs and test out the interaction/diplomacy screen. You are able to recruit other characters to join your crew but since you don't have beds, restroom facilities, etc I can't see how it would help. 

 I am recommending the game but I would say wait for the Developer to release a patch fixing the biggest issues and then go ahead and buy the game if you are interested in a hardish science fiction space game.
items.text_zh:
就像其他人说的那样，这款游戏有bug，内容也不足。但根据我观看《Neo Scavenger》的经验，我相信这款游戏最终会非常出色。

游戏开始时，你的角色在一艘飞船上，你可以选择角色的性别和代词。你还可以随机化头像的面部，但我认为游戏中没有自定义功能。接着你选择职业，并回答一份关于你如何应对特定情况的问卷，这会为你的角色提供技能和金钱。完成这些后，你可以用一些钱购买工作装备。目前装备有些有限，包括一根撬棍、激光系统（我没能弄明白怎么用）、工作手电筒、食物（这让我其中一个角色得了食物过敏并死了）。你还可以选择角色的属性，比如强壮、虚弱、天才。目前我不确定这对游戏有多大影响，但我知道食物敏感属性是有效的，还有一些控制角色情绪的属性和有效。

完成所有这些后，你可以最终确定你的角色并发射你的太空船。当你这样做时，你会从起始区域过渡到一个小型单间飞船。目前没有教程，所以你需要四处点击来弄清楚如何做某些事情。坐在导航椅上可以让你驾驶飞船，同时看着一个很酷的70年代风格（想想雷德利·斯科特的《异形》）终端。你可以锁定一个特定目的地并飞过去。这需要一些技巧，因为在你熟悉控制之前，很容易不受控制地旋转。一旦你接近目标，随着距离增加，一个接近警报器会开始发出哔哔声。你切换到对接模式，连接到目标并停靠你的飞船。对接依赖于你将飞船对齐，以便对接夹能够连接。这不太难，除非你移动得太快。

成功连接到废弃飞船后，是时候去搜寻零件了。因为你的角色是新手，没有很多钱，你最初需要分次搜寻，因为你没有EVA宇航服，而当你穿上太空服时，你只有几分钟的空气，所以你必须进入废弃飞船，卸下你想要的任何废料，然后在昏倒和死亡之前回到你的飞船。如果你设法走到这一步，你会遇到我目前发现的游戏中唯一的问题。

你的飞船，在你找到发电机之前，靠电池运行，当你的飞船产生推力、加热内部、产生空气等时，电池会耗尽。一旦电池耗尽，飞船上的所有电源都会关闭，你不再能控制你前进的方向，甚至看不到其他东西有多远。此外，我没有找到给电池充电的方法。所以在我的情况下，我只能进行一次废弃飞船之旅，然后不得不返回K-leg（第一个空间站），在那里我因为无法弄清楚如何为飞船获取更多能量而被困。不过，我通过出售从废弃飞船上拿到的废料赚了不少钱，并买了更多饮料和食物。

被困在空间站时，我能够与其他友好的NPC交谈，并测试互动/外交界面。你能够招募其他角色加入你的船员，但既然你没有床、洗手间设施等，我看不出这有什么帮助。

我推荐这款游戏，但我会说等开发者发布补丁修复最大的问题，然后如果你对一款偏硬核的科幻太空游戏感兴趣，就去买吧。
